The Missing Piece#000.src: It says it's for 'the woman on the hill'.

The Missing Piece#003.src: I have some letters that are addressed to you.
The Missing Piece#003.dst: Sana gönderilmiş birkaç mektup var bende.

The Missing Piece#004.src: Move and rotate the selected beam using the directional buttons.
The Missing Piece#004.dst: Seçili kirişi yön tuşlarıyla hareket ettir ve döndür.

The Missing Piece#005.src: You could either confront them or talk to Elise about what to do.
The Missing Piece#005.dst: Onlarla yüzleşebilir ya da ne yapacağını Elise ile konuşabilirsin.

The Missing Piece#007.src: It would be best to get the bread and get out of this place quickly.
The Missing Piece#007.dst: En iyisi ekmeği alıp buradan hemen çıkmak.

The Missing Piece#008.src: You are already carrying a bottle.

The Missing Piece#009.src: The handwriting seems familiar. But, it doesn't say much...
The Missing Piece#009.dst: El yazısı tanıdık geliyor. Ama pek bir şey söylemiyor...

The Missing Piece#010.src: Throw a Bottle by  RIGHT-CLICKING to aim and then  RIGHT-CLICKING again to throw.
The Missing Piece#010.dst: Şişe fırlatmak için  SAĞ TIKLAYIP nişan al, sonra fırlatmak için tekrar  SAĞ TIKLA.

The Missing Piece#012.src: After knocking them out,  RIGHT-CLICK to search workers.
The Missing Piece#012.dst: Bayılttıktan sonra işçilerin üstünü aramak için  SAĞ TIKLA.

The Missing Piece#013.src: Now, how to get up from here...

The Missing Piece#014.src: This must be the pipe Bush was talking about...

The Missing Piece#015.src: Hm... There's no sender... Are these all from the same person?
The Missing Piece#015.dst: Hm... Gönderen yok... Hepsi aynı kişiden mi acaba?

The Missing Piece#016.src: Pick up your post in the Post Office at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Missing Piece#018.src: Don't you see I'm busy!? Take a ticket and wait in line as you're supposed to! I don't care if no one else is here, follow protocol!
The Missing Piece#018.dst: Meşgul olduğumu görmüyor musun!? Herkes gibi numara al ve sıraya gir! Burada kimse olmaması umurumda değil, kurallara uy!
The Missing Piece#018.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#019.src: You could get across this gap by arranging the suspended beams into a path.
The Missing Piece#019.dst: Asılı kirişleri bir yol oluşturacak şekilde dizerek bu boşluğu geçebilirsin.

The Missing Piece#020.src: Oh, yes! The letters. Silly me, I almost forgot.
The Missing Piece#020.dst: Ah, evet! Mektuplar. Ne dalgınım, az kalsın unutuyordum.

The Missing Piece#022.src: Take a ticket from the Ticket Machine at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Missing Piece#023.src: You have to take a ticket, just like everyone else!
The Missing Piece#023.dst: Herkes gibi sen de numara alacaksın!
The Missing Piece#023.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#024.src: Return to the Post Office at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Missing Piece#027.src: I'll be with you in one second! Gosh, so impatient these days...
The Missing Piece#027.dst: Hemen geliyorum! Of, bu aralar herkes ne kadar sabırsız...
The Missing Piece#027.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#028.src: Tired of waiting already? Well, someone decided to leave this place a mess for when I returned!
The Missing Piece#028.dst: Beklemekten sıkıldın mı bile? Ben dönene kadar biri burayı darmadağın etmeye karar vermiş de ondan!
The Missing Piece#028.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#029.src: I come back to the office yesterday from a well-deserved, brief, eighteen week, vacation. And this is how I'm thanked?!
The Missing Piece#029.dst: Hak ettiğim kısacık, on sekiz haftalık tatilimden dün ofise döndüm. Bana teşekkür böyle mi ediliyor?!
The Missing Piece#029.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#030.src: Do you see the mess my substitute left this place in? And now I have to clean it up, or the Royal Inspector will have my head!
The Missing Piece#030.dst: Vekilimin burayı ne hâlde bıraktığını görüyor musun? Şimdi de ben toplamak zorundayım, yoksa Kraliyet Müfettişi kellemi alır!
The Missing Piece#030.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#031.src: I'll have you know I graduated with honours from the Royal University of Aelumia.
The Missing Piece#031.dst: Haberin olsun, Aelumia Kraliyet Üniversitesi'nden onur derecesiyle mezun oldum.
The Missing Piece#031.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#032.src: Frankly, it's demeaning they stuck me out here with the... ugh... peasants! Oh, and don't even get me started on the smell!
The Missing Piece#032.dst: Açıkçası beni buraya... ıyy... köylülerin arasına tıkmaları aşağılayıcı! Hele kokuyu hiç sorma!
The Missing Piece#032.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#033.src: But anyway, that is all besides the point. What did you want again?
The Missing Piece#033.dst: Neyse, bunlar konumuz dışında. Ne istiyordun, bir daha söyle?
The Missing Piece#033.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#034.src: It's you! You're the one I left in charge over my vacation, you scoundrel!
The Missing Piece#034.dst: Sensin! Tatilimde yerime bıraktığım kişi sensin, seni düzenbaz!
The Missing Piece#034.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#035.src: I knew it! A university graduate like me couldn't possibly be wrong!
The Missing Piece#035.dst: Biliyordum! Benim gibi bir üniversite mezunu asla yanılmaz!
The Missing Piece#035.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#036.src: Don't try to weasel your way out of it! A university graduate like me couldn't possibly be wrong!
The Missing Piece#036.dst: Sıyrılmaya çalışma! Benim gibi bir üniversite mezunu asla yanılmaz!
The Missing Piece#036.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#039.src: It's not just me who's going to be in trouble when the inspection comes, surely you realize that?
The Missing Piece#039.dst: Teftiş geldiğinde başı derde girecek tek kişi ben değilim, bunun farkındasın herhâlde?
The Missing Piece#039.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#041.src: If you fix this mess you made... Then no one ever has to hear a word of what happened.
The Missing Piece#041.dst: Yaptığın bu karmaşayı düzeltirsen... Olanlardan kimsenin haberi olmaz.
The Missing Piece#041.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#042.src: You don't get in trouble, the Royal Inspector is happy, I'm happy. Everyone is happy!
The Missing Piece#042.dst: Senin başın derde girmez, Kraliyet Müfettişi mutlu olur, ben mutlu olurum. Herkes mutlu!
The Missing Piece#042.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#045.src: Then I'll have you sorting post like your life depends on it, scoundrel!
The Missing Piece#045.dst: O zaman hayatın buna bağlıymış gibi posta ayıracaksın, düzenbaz!
The Missing Piece#045.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#048.dst: Posta Müdürü'nü [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] konumuna kadar takip et.

The Missing Piece#049.src: Sorting is so easy even someone like you should be able to do it.
The Missing Piece#049.dst: Ayırmak o kadar kolay ki senin gibi biri bile yapabilir.
The Missing Piece#049.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#050.src: All you do is take the packages from the conveyor over there.
The Missing Piece#050.dst: Tek yapacağın şuradaki banttan paketleri almak.
The Missing Piece#050.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#051.src: And put them where they're supposed to go over there.
The Missing Piece#051.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#052.src: {p} packages to the {p}, Auburn packages to the {p}, and so on.
The Missing Piece#052.dst: {p} paketleri {p} bölmesine, Auburn paketleri {p} bölmesine, falan filan.
The Missing Piece#052.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#054.src: Fantastic! Just don't make a mess of it, okay?
The Missing Piece#054.dst: Harika! Yalnız ortalığı batırma, tamam mı?
The Missing Piece#054.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#058.src: Well, that was just the warmup! There's more to come, so don't go slacking off now!
The Missing Piece#058.dst: Eh, o sadece ısınmaydı! Daha fazlası geliyor, sakın tembellik yapma!
The Missing Piece#058.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#059.src: Hmm... You did fine this time, but watch out, because these last packages come fast!
The Missing Piece#059.dst: Hmm... Bu sefer fena değildin, ama dikkat et, son paketler hızlı geliyor!
The Missing Piece#059.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#060.src: Don't think you're somebody just because you can sort some packages!
The Missing Piece#060.dst: Birkaç paket ayırdın diye kendini bir şey sanma!
The Missing Piece#060.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#061.src: What are you doing over there!?
The Missing Piece#061.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#062.src: Agh! Try again, but you better do it right this time!
The Missing Piece#062.dst: Ah! Bir daha dene, ama bu sefer doğru yapsan iyi olur!
The Missing Piece#062.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#064.src: Don't bother me while I'm working! I didn't go to university just to slack off with people like you!
The Missing Piece#064.dst: Çalışırken beni rahatsız etme! Senin gibilerle tembellik edeyim diye üniversite okumadım ben!
The Missing Piece#064.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#066.src: Ah, perfect! You sorted the packages!
The Missing Piece#066.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#067.src: But wait, what's this then? Why are there so many packages to the {p}?
The Missing Piece#067.dst: Ama dur, bu da ne? Neden {p} bölmesine bu kadar çok paket var?
The Missing Piece#067.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#068.src: Did you mess up the sorting, you fool!?
The Missing Piece#068.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#069.src: What's up with these packages! They're filled with letters?
The Missing Piece#069.dst: Bu paketlerin nesi var böyle! İçleri mektup dolu?
The Missing Piece#069.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#070.src: Hmph... all of them to the woman on the hill... Whatever that means!
The Missing Piece#070.dst: Hıh... hepsi tepedeki kadına... Her ne demekse!
The Missing Piece#070.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#071.src: Hey you, scoundrel. This is part of your duty too, you know!
The Missing Piece#071.dst: Hey sen, düzenbaz. Bu da senin görevinin bir parçası, haberin olsun!
The Missing Piece#071.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#072.src: Go deliver these letters! Or... or I'll tell the Royal Inspector about what you did! That's right, don't mess with me!
The Missing Piece#072.dst: Git bu mektupları teslim et! Yoksa... yoksa yaptığını Kraliyet Müfettişi'ne söylerim! Aynen öyle, benimle uğraşma!
The Missing Piece#072.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#073.src: How should I know! That's your job to figure out. See, it says here 'to the woman on the hill', that should be enough shouldn't it?
The Missing Piece#073.dst: Ben nereden bileyim! Onu bulmak senin işin. Bak, burada 'tepedeki kadına' yazıyor, bu kadarı yeter, değil mi?
The Missing Piece#073.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#074.src: Oh, but you are! I have very many friends, in very high places! Met them in university, makes sure to remember that!
The Missing Piece#074.dst: Ah, ama öylesin! Çok yüksek yerlerde çok sayıda arkadaşım var! Onlarla üniversitede tanıştım, bunu aklından çıkarma!
The Missing Piece#074.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#075.src: Great! Now with that settled I can finally go back to my very important work.
The Missing Piece#075.dst: Harika! Bu iş hallolduğuna göre nihayet çok önemli işlerime dönebilirim.
The Missing Piece#075.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#076.src: Oh, yes. Very important. University graduate, did I mention that?
The Missing Piece#076.dst: Ah, evet. Çok önemli. Üniversite mezunuyum, söylemiş miydim?
The Missing Piece#076.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#077.src: Now now, off you go. And don't come back crying if you can't find this mysterious woman!
The Missing Piece#077.dst: Hadi bakalım, yürü. Bu gizemli kadını bulamazsan da ağlayarak geri gelme!
The Missing Piece#077.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#078.src: But if you lose the letter I can always give you another, they seem to be practically infinite anyhow!
The Missing Piece#078.dst: Ama mektubu kaybedersen sana her zaman bir tane daha verebilirim, zaten neredeyse sonsuz gibiler!
The Missing Piece#078.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#079.src: Find out about the woman on the hill around [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Missing Piece#080.src: Are you trying to slack off? You still have the letter on you, go deliver it!
The Missing Piece#080.dst: Kaytarmaya mı çalışıyorsun? Mektup hâlâ üstünde, git teslim et!
The Missing Piece#080.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#082.src: Hmm, you lost the letter? Already!?
The Missing Piece#082.dst: Hmm, mektubu kaybettin mi? Şimdiden mi!?
The Missing Piece#082.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#083.src: Don't think you're getting out of this! I have spares!
The Missing Piece#083.dst: Bu işten yakayı sıyıracağını sanma! Yedeklerim var!
The Missing Piece#083.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#084.src: Now go on and sort this out for me, won't you? I have enough to worry about as is without you bungling about!
The Missing Piece#084.dst: Hadi git de şu işi benim için hallet, olur mu? Sen ortalıkta işleri yüzüne gözüne bulaştırmadan da yeterince derdim var!
The Missing Piece#084.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#086.src: Looking for someone, huh? 'round these parts it's usually the tin cans who do that.
The Missing Piece#086.dst: Birini mi arıyorsun, ha? Buralarda o işi genelde teneke kafalar yapar.
The Missing Piece#086.speaker: Vagabond

The Missing Piece#087.src: A visit from one of those and you get an all-expenses-paid vacation on the Crown, if you catch my drift.
The Missing Piece#087.dst: Onlardan biri sana uğrarsa, masrafları Kraliyet'ten bir tatile çıkarsın, ne demek istediğimi anladın sen.
The Missing Piece#087.speaker: Vagabond

The Missing Piece#088.src: Safe to say, if it were Lars you were looking for I'd be happy to rat him out, but you haven't told me who it is yet.
The Missing Piece#088.dst: Şunu diyeyim, aradığın Lars olsaydı onu seve seve ele verirdim, ama kim olduğunu hâlâ söylemedin.
The Missing Piece#088.speaker: Vagabond

The Missing Piece#089.src: PLenty of hills 'round these parts, women too. But they're in the factories, slaving away, not on any hills 'sfar as I'm aware.
The Missing Piece#089.dst: Buralarda bol bol tepe var, kadın da. Ama kadınlar fabrikalarda köle gibi çalışıyor, bildiğim kadarıyla tepelerde değil.
The Missing Piece#089.speaker: Vagabond

The Missing Piece#090.src: Sorry bud, don't think I can help you with this one. Try asking Lars, he's usually hogging the fire in the alley here behind me. Hate that guy...
The Missing Piece#090.dst: Kusura bakma dostum, bu konuda sana yardım edemem herhâlde. Lars'a sor, genelde arkamdaki ara sokakta ateşin başını tutar. Sevmem o herifi...
The Missing Piece#090.speaker: Vagabond

The Missing Piece#092.src: Already told you everythin', didn't I? Go harass Lars instead, I have nothing more to say.
The Missing Piece#092.dst: Sana her şeyi anlattım zaten, değil mi? Git Lars'ın başının etini ye, benim söyleyecek başka bir şeyim yok.
The Missing Piece#092.speaker: Vagabond

The Missing Piece#094.src: I'm looking for someone called 'the woman on the hill'. I have a letter I need to deliver to her.
The Missing Piece#094.dst: 'Tepedeki kadın' diye birini arıyorum. Ona teslim etmem gereken bir mektup var.
The Missing Piece#094.speaker: Vagrant

The Missing Piece#095.src: A letter? Don't know nuthin' about no woman on the hill, but maybe Bush over there would know.
The Missing Piece#095.dst: Mektup mu? Tepedeki kadın mepedeki kadın bilmem ben, ama oradaki Bush bilir belki.
The Missing Piece#095.speaker: Vagrant

The Missing Piece#096.src: He usually knows things... He's a knower.
The Missing Piece#096.dst: O genelde bir şeyler bilir... Bilen biridir.
The Missing Piece#096.speaker: Vagrant

The Missing Piece#097.src: Don't talk to him for too long though, or he'll start putting strange ideas in your head...
The Missing Piece#097.dst: Ama onunla çok uzun konuşma, yoksa kafana tuhaf fikirler sokmaya başlar...
The Missing Piece#097.speaker: Vagrant

The Missing Piece#099.src: Ask Bush. I told you I don't know nuthin'.
The Missing Piece#099.dst: Bush'a sor. Dedim ya, bi' şey bilmem ben.
The Missing Piece#099.speaker: Vagrant

The Missing Piece#100.src: I'm Bush, nice to meet you. Is there something you wish to know?
The Missing Piece#100.dst: Ben Bush, tanıştığımıza memnun oldum. Bilmek istediğin bir şey var mı?
The Missing Piece#100.speaker: Bush

The Missing Piece#101.src: Oh, yes, her... This bush knows her all too well!
The Missing Piece#101.dst: Ah, evet, o... Bu çalı onu pek iyi bilir!
The Missing Piece#101.speaker: Bush

The Missing Piece#102.src: Without her this bush would wilt! Yes, a bush requires water to grow. I know, I know!
The Missing Piece#102.dst: O olmasa bu çalı kururdu! Evet, çalının büyümek için suya ihtiyacı var. Biliyorum, biliyorum!
The Missing Piece#102.speaker: Bush

The Missing Piece#103.src: But first, I must know why you must know! Do you know?
The Missing Piece#103.dst: Ama önce neden bilmen gerektiğini bilmeliyim! Biliyor musun?
The Missing Piece#103.speaker: Bush

The Missing Piece#104.src: A letter! If only this Bush could know its contents... Alas, it would be rude to know...
The Missing Piece#104.dst: Bir mektup! Keşke bu Bush içinde ne yazdığını bilebilseydi... Heyhat, bilmek kabalık olur...
The Missing Piece#104.speaker: Bush

The Missing Piece#105.src: The mail-deliverer, truly a noble profession. I will share with you her location, but in exchange you must tell her: her friend is back in town.
The Missing Piece#105.dst: Postacılık, ne asil bir meslek. Sana yerini söyleyeceğim, ama karşılığında ona şunu söylemelisin: arkadaşı kasabaya geri döndü.
The Missing Piece#105.speaker: Bush

The Missing Piece#106.src: Here, let me write it down for you!
The Missing Piece#106.speaker: Bush

The Missing Piece#107.src: Now you know! Now you know!
The Missing Piece#107.speaker: Bush

The Missing Piece#108.src: To know why I must know? Not even I know... All I know is that I must know!
The Missing Piece#108.dst: Neden bilmem gerektiğini bilmek mi? Ben bile bilmiyorum... Tek bildiğim, bilmem gerektiği!
The Missing Piece#108.speaker: Bush

The Missing Piece#109.src: Again, tell me why you must know.
The Missing Piece#109.dst: Bir daha söyle, neden bilmen gerekiyor?
The Missing Piece#109.speaker: Bush

The Missing Piece#110.src: Nothing? That such people existed, I did not know! Now I know, now I know!
The Missing Piece#110.dst: Hiçbir şey mi? Böyle insanların var olduğunu bilmiyordum! Şimdi biliyorum, şimdi biliyorum!
The Missing Piece#110.speaker: Bush

The Missing Piece#114.src: Post? You must be at the wrong house, dear.
The Missing Piece#114.dst: Posta mı? Yanlış eve gelmişsin, canım.
The Missing Piece#114.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#115.src: No one is sending me any of that...
The Missing Piece#115.dst: Bana öyle şeyler gönderen kimse yok...
The Missing Piece#115.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#116.src: Well, if it says so on the letter...
The Missing Piece#116.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#117.src: Come in and we'll talk about it.
The Missing Piece#117.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#119.src: I don't usually get a lot of visitors up on the hill.
The Missing Piece#119.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#122.dst: Kadını içeride [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] konumuna kadar takip et.

The Missing Piece#124.src: Place the letters on the table at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Missing Piece#127.src: I think I'll need a closer look at this.
The Missing Piece#127.dst: Sanırım buna daha yakından bakmam gerek.
The Missing Piece#127.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#128.src: Please, have a seat. I'll make you something to drink.
The Missing Piece#128.dst: Lütfen otur. Sana içecek bir şeyler hazırlayayım.
The Missing Piece#128.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#130.src: You don't look like you're from around these parts, do you?
The Missing Piece#130.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#131.src: Hmm? Well, I shouldn't pry into my guest's secrets. Better to let the unexplained rest, ha. Wouldn't you agree?
The Missing Piece#131.dst: Hm? Neyse, misafirimin sırlarını kurcalamamalıyım. Açıklanamayanı rahat bırakmak en iyisi, ha. Sen de öyle düşünmez misin?
The Missing Piece#131.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#132.src: Here in the Roughworks, we don't have any secrets. At least that's what Her Majesty wants to believe, ha.
The Missing Piece#132.dst: Burada, Roughworks'te hiçbir sırrımız yoktur. En azından Majesteleri öyle inanmak istiyor, ha.
The Missing Piece#132.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#133.src: That's why I chose to live here. In the neighborhoods, the walls are thinner than paper. Nothing goes unheard.
The Missing Piece#133.dst: Burada yaşamayı bu yüzden seçtim. Mahallelerde duvarlar kâğıttan ince. Hiçbir şey duyulmadan kalmaz.
The Missing Piece#133.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#134.src: Up here on the hill, it's much more peaceful. As long as the Water Authority doesn't come knocking, ha.
The Missing Piece#134.dst: Burada, tepede, çok daha huzurlu. Su İdaresi kapıyı çalmadığı sürece, ha.
The Missing Piece#134.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#135.src: Well, if you're already here, why don't we have a little chat? Not a lot of people to talk to up here!
The Missing Piece#135.dst: Madem buradasın, biraz sohbet etsek mi? Burada konuşacak pek kimse yok!
The Missing Piece#135.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#136.src: Pick up the Watering Can outside at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Missing Piece#137.src: The watering can is just outside in the garden. There are three plants inside and three plants outside.
The Missing Piece#137.dst: Sulama kabı hemen dışarıda, bahçede. İçeride üç bitki, dışarıda üç bitki var.
The Missing Piece#137.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#138.src: Water Elise's plants while she reads the letters.

The Missing Piece#140.src: Oh, what a mess... trying to make sense of this is making my head hurt.
The Missing Piece#140.dst: Ah, ne karmaşa... bunu anlamaya çalışmak başımı ağrıttı.
The Missing Piece#140.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#141.src: So many letters, over so many years... who would possibly be so insistent on reaching me?
The Missing Piece#141.dst: Bunca mektup, bunca yıl boyunca... kim bana ulaşmakta bu kadar ısrar eder ki?
The Missing Piece#141.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#142.src: Hm? Oh, you finished watering the plants already? That was quick!
The Missing Piece#142.dst: Hm? Ah, bitkileri sulamayı bitirdin mi bile? Ne çabuk!
The Missing Piece#142.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#143.src: Well, I certainly won't make any progress like this, and it seems we both are in need of a break.
The Missing Piece#143.dst: Eh, böyle hiç ilerleyemeyeceğim, ikimizin de bir molaya ihtiyacı var gibi.
The Missing Piece#143.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#144.src: Oh, it's such a lovely day today... Why don't we go outside and enjoy the garden for a bit?
The Missing Piece#144.dst: Ah, bugün ne güzel bir gün... Neden dışarı çıkıp biraz bahçenin tadını çıkarmıyoruz?
The Missing Piece#144.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#145.src: Follow Elise outside and take a seat at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
The Missing Piece#145.dst: Elise'in peşinden dışarı çık ve [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] konumunda otur.

The Missing Piece#147.src: It really is beautiful today, isn't it?
The Missing Piece#147.dst: Bugün gerçekten çok güzel, değil mi?
The Missing Piece#147.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#148.src: Ah... freshly watered flowers. Nothing beats that smell.
The Missing Piece#148.dst: Ah... yeni sulanmış çiçekler. Bu kokunun üstüne yoktur.
The Missing Piece#148.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#149.src: Hm. Do you see that tree over there?
The Missing Piece#149.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#150.src: It's the only one of its kind in the whole of the Roughworks. Isn't it beautiful?
The Missing Piece#150.dst: Bütün Roughworks'te türünün tek örneği. Güzel değil mi?
The Missing Piece#150.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#151.src: It was a gift, but from who... It's another thing I've forgotten.
The Missing Piece#151.dst: Bir hediyeydi, ama kimden... Bu da unuttuğum şeylerden biri.
The Missing Piece#151.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#152.src: It's frustrating, so frustrating... All these precious memories...
The Missing Piece#152.dst: Sinir bozucu, öyle sinir bozucu ki... Bütün o değerli anılar...
The Missing Piece#152.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#154.src: It isn't much now, that is for certain.
The Missing Piece#154.dst: Şimdilik pek bir şeye benzemiyor, orası kesin.

The Missing Piece#155.src: Well. It's beautiful already, don't you think?
The Missing Piece#155.dst: Eh. Bence şimdiden güzel, sence de öyle değil mi?
The Missing Piece#155.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#157.src: Ha! Of course it will, it's a tree!
The Missing Piece#157.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#158.src: Oh, you know I didn't mean it like that.

The Missing Piece#159.src: For each year that passes... this tree will grow taller, and ever more beautiful.
The Missing Piece#159.dst: Geçen her yılla... bu ağaç daha da uzayacak, daha da güzelleşecek.

The Missing Piece#160.src: It'll have to weather many storms, and on some days it might even have to go without water. And still, it will continue growing.
The Missing Piece#160.dst: Pek çok fırtınaya göğüs germesi gerekecek, bazı günler susuz bile kalacak belki. Ama yine de büyümeye devam edecek.

The Missing Piece#162.src: And then in ten, fifteen, maybe even twenty-five years... we'll finally be able to rest in its shade.
The Missing Piece#162.dst: Sonra on, on beş, belki yirmi beş yıl sonra... sonunda gölgesinde dinlenebileceğiz.

The Missing Piece#163.src: Twenty-five years!? We'll be old by then!
The Missing Piece#163.dst: Yirmi beş yıl mı!? O zamana kadar yaşlanırız!
The Missing Piece#163.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#164.src: Oh, I know! We could have a picnic underneath its canopy Doesn't that sound nice, {u}?
The Missing Piece#164.dst: Ah, buldum! Dallarının altında piknik yapabiliriz. Kulağa hoş gelmiyor mu, {u}?
The Missing Piece#164.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#165.src: ... It does. It does sound nice, Elise. Perhaps we could.
The Missing Piece#165.dst: ... Geliyor. Gerçekten hoş geliyor, Elise. Belki yaparız.

The Missing Piece#166.src: Go on, give it some more water. Or it'll never grow an inch!
The Missing Piece#166.dst: Hadi, biraz daha su ver. Yoksa bir karış bile büyümez!

The Missing Piece#171.src: I was just thinking... If I were to die some day, I'd like to be buried here, under the tree.
The Missing Piece#171.dst: Düşünüyordum da... Bir gün ölürsem, buraya, bu ağacın altına gömülmek isterim.

The Missing Piece#172.src: Huh? What could possibly make you think about such silly things? We still have a long life left ahead of us, don't we?
The Missing Piece#172.dst: Ha? Böyle saçma şeyler nereden aklına geliyor? Önümüzde daha uzun bir hayat var, değil mi?
The Missing Piece#172.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#173.src: Of course, you're right. I'm sorry, I'm just not used to this...
The Missing Piece#173.dst: Tabii, haklısın. Özür dilerim, sadece buna alışık değilim...

The Missing Piece#176.src: Let's just enjoy the sun, for a bit. There's still work tomorrow.
The Missing Piece#176.dst: Hadi biraz güneşin tadını çıkaralım. Yarın yine iş var.
The Missing Piece#176.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#177.dst: Ah... Hah, az önce ne oldu...?
The Missing Piece#177.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#179.src: Hm. I shall leave the worrying for another day, I think. Today is a good day... not a day for worrying.
The Missing Piece#179.dst: Hm. Sanırım endişelenmeyi başka bir güne bırakacağım. Bugün güzel bir gün... endişelenecek gün değil.
The Missing Piece#179.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#180.src: In fact, today is too nice a day to waste it... by not going anywhere, that is. Wouldn't you agree?
The Missing Piece#180.dst: Hatta bugün, boşa harcanmayacak kadar güzel... bir yere gitmeyerek yani. Sen de öyle düşünmüyor musun?
The Missing Piece#180.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#182.src: Follow Elise to the roof at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
The Missing Piece#182.dst: Elise'i [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] konumundaki çatıya kadar takip et.

The Missing Piece#183.src: Ah... Do you see that factory off that way? I used to work there, back when I was younger...
The Missing Piece#183.dst: Ah... Şu taraftaki fabrikayı görüyor musun? Gençken orada çalışırdım...
The Missing Piece#183.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#184.src: We mass-produced bread for the higher regions... Tedious work, and thankless too.
The Missing Piece#184.dst: Yukarı bölgeler için seri ekmek üretirdik... Sıkıcı bir işti, üstelik kimse teşekkür etmezdi.
The Missing Piece#184.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#185.src: I'm sure you have noticed, but things around here aren't too easy. Some people even go as far as stealing when times are tough...
The Missing Piece#185.dst: Eminim fark etmişsindir, buralarda işler pek kolay değil. Zor zamanlarda bazıları hırsızlığa bile başvuruyor...
The Missing Piece#185.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#186.src: Fortunately... I never had to. They would let us take some home, every once in a while.
The Missing Piece#186.dst: Neyse ki... ben hiç mecbur kalmadım. Arada bir eve biraz götürmemize izin verirlerdi.
The Missing Piece#186.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#187.src: Those were good days. On those occasions, we'd go and have ourselves a picnic, me and- hm. Just me, I suppose.
The Missing Piece#187.dst: Güzel günlerdi. Öyle zamanlarda gidip piknik yapardık, ben ve- hm. Sadece ben, herhâlde.
The Missing Piece#187.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#188.src: A shame it's so hard to come by... the thefts became a real problem, you know. The Crown ended up building a vault down under the factory to keep it all secure!
The Missing Piece#188.dst: Bulması bu kadar zor olması ne yazık... hırsızlıklar gerçekten başa bela olmuştu, biliyor musun. Sonunda Kraliyet hepsini güvende tutmak için fabrikanın altına bir mahzen yaptırdı!
The Missing Piece#188.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#189.src: A shame it's so hard to come by... the thefts became a real problem, you know. The Crown ended up building a vault down under the factory to keep it all secure.
The Missing Piece#189.dst: Bulması bu kadar zor olması ne yazık... hırsızlıklar gerçekten başa bela olmuştu, biliyor musun. Sonunda Kraliyet hepsini güvende tutmak için fabrikanın altına bir mahzen yaptırdı.
The Missing Piece#189.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#190.src: The door is locked. A note is plastered on the front.
The Missing Piece#190.dst: Kapı kilitli. Önüne bir not yapıştırılmış.

The Missing Piece#191.src: Now to find a way inside without being caught...
The Missing Piece#191.dst: Şimdi yakalanmadan içeri girmenin bir yolunu bulmalı...

The Missing Piece#192.src: How long, since I last had some? Years, surely... not like any of that bread ever makes it to us poor folk, ha!
The Missing Piece#192.dst: En son ne zaman yemiştim? Yıllar olmuştur herhâlde... o ekmekten biz yoksullara hiç kısmet olmaz ki, ha!
The Missing Piece#192.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#193.src: But it'd be nice to have some again, I suppose... reminisce on old times.
The Missing Piece#193.dst: Ama yeniden biraz yemek güzel olurdu sanırım... eski günleri anmak için.
The Missing Piece#193.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#194.src: Well, if you're running errands for me already... mind seeing if you can get your hands on a loaf or two?
The Missing Piece#194.dst: Madem zaten benim için ayak işi yapıyorsun... bir iki somun bulabilir misin, bir bakar mısın?
The Missing Piece#194.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#195.src: It's expensive, but for the right price... I'm sure you could get ahold of some. You don't seem the sort to struggle with that kind of thing, do you, letter carrier?
The Missing Piece#195.dst: Pahalıdır, ama doğru fiyata... eminim biraz bulabilirsin. Sen bu tür işlerde zorlanacak birine benzemiyorsun, değil mi, postacı?
The Missing Piece#195.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#196.src: Ha! Well, do your best, either way. Once you come back, I have a plan for what we can do today. How's that sound?
The Missing Piece#196.dst: Ha! Neyse, elinden geleni yap. Döndüğünde bugün ne yapacağımıza dair bir planım var. Nasıl, iyi mi?
The Missing Piece#196.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#197.src: Try to enter the Bread Factory at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Missing Piece#198.src: Oh, no... You know! You know! Speak to that constable first, and perhaps, I'll tell you more.
The Missing Piece#198.dst: Ah, hayır... Biliyorsun! Biliyorsun! Önce şu bekçiyle konuş, sonra belki sana daha fazlasını anlatırım.
The Missing Piece#198.speaker: Bush

The Missing Piece#199.src: If you've come to beg, you might as well leave.
The Missing Piece#199.speaker: Constable

The Missing Piece#200.src: Huh? Alright, bud. We all do.
The Missing Piece#200.speaker: Constable

The Missing Piece#202.src: Do I look like a vending machine to you? Go find somewhere else. We just make bread here, we don't sell it.
The Missing Piece#202.dst: Sana otomat gibi mi görünüyorum? Başka yere git. Biz burada ekmek yaparız, satmayız.
The Missing Piece#202.speaker: Constable

The Missing Piece#203.src: Get out of here pal, you shouldn't be loitering around under a Constable's watch.
The Missing Piece#203.dst: Defol buradan ahbap, bir bekçinin gözü önünde ortalıkta dolanmamalısın.
The Missing Piece#203.speaker: Constable

The Missing Piece#204.src: But, but, but! No buts. Don't make me have to do something! The paperwork is always such a hassle...
The Missing Piece#204.dst: Ama, ama, ama! Aması yok. Beni bir şey yapmak zorunda bırakma! Evrak işleri hep ayrı bir dert...
The Missing Piece#204.speaker: Constable

The Missing Piece#206.src: Obviously not... We have enough problems as it is, what with that stolen barrel last week... And the production quotas...
The Missing Piece#206.dst: Elbette hayır... Zaten yeterince derdimiz var, geçen hafta çalınan fıçı... Bir de üretim kotaları...
The Missing Piece#206.speaker: Constable

The Missing Piece#207.src: Don't you have something better to do anyway?
The Missing Piece#207.dst: Senin yapacak daha iyi bir işin yok mu zaten?
The Missing Piece#207.speaker: Constable

The Missing Piece#209.src: Over here, friend of a friend!

The Missing Piece#211.src: Did you know? Did you know? There is more than one way to enter any building.
The Missing Piece#211.dst: Biliyor muydun? Biliyor muydun? Her binaya girmenin birden fazla yolu vardır.
The Missing Piece#211.speaker: Bush

The Missing Piece#212.src: I'll tell you! But, stealing is unethical, you must know!
The Missing Piece#212.dst: Söyleyeceğim! Ama hırsızlık ahlaksızlıktır, bunu bilmelisin!
The Missing Piece#212.speaker: Bush

The Missing Piece#213.src: As long as she doesn't know! She won't know! Do you understand?
The Missing Piece#213.dst: Yeter ki o bilmesin! Bilmeyecek de! Anlıyor musun?
The Missing Piece#213.speaker: Bush

The Missing Piece#214.src: It's just around the corner, you see. A pipe! Now you know! Now you know!
The Missing Piece#214.dst: Hemen köşede, görürsün. Bir boru! Artık biliyorsun! Artık biliyorsun!
The Missing Piece#214.speaker: Bush

The Missing Piece#215.src: Enter the Bread Factory through the pipe at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Missing Piece#218.src: Find a way to enter the Bread Vault through the elevator at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
The Missing Piece#218.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] konumundaki asansörle Ekmek Mahzeni'ne girmenin bir yolunu bul.

The Missing Piece#221.src: Uhh? That's not an answer! Now, tell me who you are or I'll have a look for myself! And I never forget faces, keep that in mind!
The Missing Piece#221.dst: Hıı? Bu cevap değil! Şimdi kim olduğunu söyle, yoksa kendim bakarım! Ve ben yüzleri asla unutmam, bunu aklında tut!
The Missing Piece#221.speaker: Supervisor

The Missing Piece#222.src: What's a worker doing in my office!? Now, tell me who you are or I'll have a look for myself! And I never forget faces, keep that in mind!
The Missing Piece#222.dst: Ofisimde bir işçinin ne işi var!? Şimdi kim olduğunu söyle, yoksa kendim bakarım! Ve ben yüzleri asla unutmam, bunu aklında tut!
The Missing Piece#222.speaker: Supervisor

The Missing Piece#224.src: Well, thank you for bringing this to my attention! I will investigate the matter immediately!
The Missing Piece#224.dst: Bunu dikkatime sunduğun için teşekkürler! Konuyu derhâl araştıracağım!
The Missing Piece#224.speaker: Supervisor

The Missing Piece#226.src: Make your way through the Bread Vault to [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Missing Piece#228.src: Hit the bottles at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] with a Bottle.
The Missing Piece#228.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] konumundaki şişeleri bir Şişe ile vur.

The Missing Piece#229.src: Continue through the Bread Vault to [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Missing Piece#230.src: Use the beams to make it across to [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Missing Piece#232.src: ...and in accordance with our protocols, we will require a detailed record of this former employee. Years of employment, known associates, work performance... all of it.
The Missing Piece#232.dst: ...ve protokollerimiz gereğince, bu eski çalışan hakkında ayrıntılı bir kayıt talep edeceğiz. Çalıştığı yıllar, bilinen bağlantıları, iş performansı... hepsi.
The Missing Piece#232.speaker: Inquisitor

The Missing Piece#233.src: Naturally, I will comply to the best of my ability, blessed be Her Grace. But to think that the mere theft of one crate would reach this high a level...
The Missing Piece#233.dst: Elbette, elimden geldiğince uyacağım, Majesteleri kutsansın. Ama tek bir kasanın çalınmasının bu kadar yukarılara ulaşacağını düşünmek...
The Missing Piece#233.speaker: Vault Chief

The Missing Piece#234.src: The crate is not relevant. It is the employee who is of interest. Further measures may be necessary, but the records will do well to begin with.
The Missing Piece#234.dst: Kasa önemli değil. İlgilendiğimiz kişi çalışan. Ek önlemler gerekebilir, ama başlangıç için kayıtlar yeterli olacaktır.
The Missing Piece#234.speaker: Inquisitor

The Missing Piece#235.src: ...only the employee? Pardon my questions, but I do not understand why she is of interest to you.
The Missing Piece#235.dst: ...yalnızca çalışan mı? Sorularımı mazur görün, ama onunla neden ilgilendiğinizi anlamıyorum.
The Missing Piece#235.speaker: Vault Chief

The Missing Piece#236.src: That is for us to know, and for you to comply. But it pertains to a potential security breach which we are investigating.
The Missing Piece#236.dst: Bilmek bize, uymak size düşer. Ama soruşturduğumuz olası bir güvenlik ihlaliyle ilgili.
The Missing Piece#236.speaker: Inquisitor

The Missing Piece#237.src: At my factory? What are you implying!?
The Missing Piece#237.dst: Benim fabrikamda mı? Ne ima ediyorsunuz!?
The Missing Piece#237.speaker: Vault Chief

The Missing Piece#238.src: I imply nothing. Must you be reminded of your position? It is by Her Majesty's will that I am here today. Do you truly wish to stand against it?
The Missing Piece#238.dst: Hiçbir şey ima etmiyorum. Haddinizi size hatırlatmam mı gerekiyor? Bugün burada bulunmam Majesteleri'nin iradesidir. Gerçekten buna karşı mı çıkmak istiyorsunuz?
The Missing Piece#238.speaker: Inquisitor

The Missing Piece#239.src: I... I humbly apologize... I didn't mean-
The Missing Piece#239.dst: Ben... Naçizane özür dilerim... Öyle demek istemedim-
The Missing Piece#239.speaker: Vault Chief

The Missing Piece#241.src: Y-yes, of course. But, still, I had thought that matter was settled years ago! What connection could it possibly have to-
The Missing Piece#241.dst: E-evet, elbette. Ama yine de, o meselenin yıllar önce kapandığını sanıyordum! Bununla ne bağlantısı olabilir ki-
The Missing Piece#241.speaker: Vault Chief

The Missing Piece#242.src: Enough aimless rambling. My time is limited. Pull up those records on this Elise, immediately.
The Missing Piece#242.dst: Bu kadar boş laf yeter. Vaktim kısıtlı. Şu Elise'in kayıtlarını derhâl getirin.
The Missing Piece#242.speaker: Inquisitor

The Missing Piece#243.src: U-understood, ma'am... I'll get them right away.
The Missing Piece#243.speaker: Vault Chief

The Missing Piece#245.src: Acquire the bread from the barrel at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Missing Piece#247.src: Find the way out of the Bread Vault at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Missing Piece#248.src: Well, well, well... it would seem the rats aren't the only plague to infest this place.
The Missing Piece#248.dst: Vay, vay, vay... görünen o ki buraya musallat olan tek bela fareler değilmiş.
The Missing Piece#248.speaker: Inquisitor

The Missing Piece#249.src: And here I had thought this particular lead was dead end! Only years-old records which tell us nothing we did not already know... always a risk, but worth checking regardless.
The Missing Piece#249.dst: Ben de bu ipucunun çıkmaz sokak olduğunu düşünmüştüm! Zaten bilmediğimiz hiçbir şeyi söylemeyen yıllanmış kayıtlar... her zaman bir risk, ama yine de bakmaya değer.
The Missing Piece#249.speaker: Inquisitor

The Missing Piece#250.src: But here you are. One of the province's most wanted criminals. What a strange coincidence, finding you here.
The Missing Piece#250.dst: Ama işte buradasın. Eyaletin en çok aranan suçlularından biri. Seni burada bulmak ne tuhaf bir tesadüf.
The Missing Piece#250.speaker: Inquisitor

The Missing Piece#251.src: I must wonder... for what reason are you here?
The Missing Piece#251.dst: Merak ediyorum... burada ne işin var?
The Missing Piece#251.speaker: Inquisitor

The Missing Piece#252.src: I know better than to expect an answer. But it does not matter, in the end. We will get it out of you eventually.
The Missing Piece#252.dst: Cevap beklemeyecek kadar akıllıyım. Ama sonuçta önemi yok. Er ya da geç ağzından alacağız.
The Missing Piece#252.speaker: Inquisitor

The Missing Piece#256.src: Return to the Roughworks through the pipe at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Missing Piece#258.src: Confront the inspection or talk to Elise at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
The Missing Piece#258.dst: Teftiş ekibiyle yüzleş ya da [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] konumunda Elise ile konuş.

The Missing Piece#259.src: Oh, it's the Water Authority! I don't know why they're here... but it can't be for any good reason.
The Missing Piece#259.dst: Ah, Su İdaresi! Neden geldiklerini bilmiyorum... ama hayırlı bir sebep olamaz.
The Missing Piece#259.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#260.src: Open up already! We know you're in there!
The Missing Piece#260.speaker: Inspector

The Missing Piece#261.src: Really, you should hide. It's okay, I've dealt with their type before. I'll send them away.
The Missing Piece#261.dst: Gerçekten, saklanmalısın. Merak etme, onların tayfasıyla daha önce de uğraştım. Onları gönderirim.
The Missing Piece#261.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#263.src: Good. Quick, find somewhere to hide!
The Missing Piece#263.dst: Güzel. Çabuk, saklanacak bir yer bul!
The Missing Piece#263.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#264.src: Wait one second! I'll hide behind the plant!
The Missing Piece#264.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#268.src: A friend, you say? Then you should be able to tell me why she's not answering the door!
The Missing Piece#268.dst: Arkadaşı mı dedin? O zaman neden kapıyı açmadığını söyleyebilirsin bana!
The Missing Piece#268.speaker: Inspector

The Missing Piece#270.src: Someone like me!? What's that supposed to mean?
The Missing Piece#270.dst: Benim gibi biri mi!? Ne demek oluyor o?
The Missing Piece#270.speaker: Inspector

The Missing Piece#271.src: Oh, you'll pay for this insult! We have authority to enforce our orders with force, you know! We can do anything we want!
The Missing Piece#271.dst: Ah, bu hakaretin bedelini ödeyeceksin! Emirlerimizi zorla uygulama yetkimiz var, biliyor musun! İstediğimiz her şeyi yapabiliriz!
The Missing Piece#271.speaker: Inspector

The Missing Piece#272.src: Not at home, you say? How convenient. Just as the inspection comes around they're not at home to greet us!
The Missing Piece#272.dst: Evde değil mi dedin? Ne kadar da denk gelmiş. Tam teftiş zamanı bizi karşılamak için evde değil!
The Missing Piece#272.speaker: Inspector

The Missing Piece#273.src: It's almost like someone tipped them off, don't you think?
The Missing Piece#273.dst: Sanki biri ona haber vermiş gibi, değil mi?
The Missing Piece#273.speaker: Inspector

The Missing Piece#274.src: Say friend, did you tip off the subject that we were coming?
The Missing Piece#274.dst: Söyle bakalım arkadaş, geleceğimizi şahsa sen mi haber verdin?
The Missing Piece#274.speaker: Inspector

The Missing Piece#275.src: Very well, then. But we will still need to get in to conduct the search.
The Missing Piece#275.dst: Pekâlâ. Ama aramayı yapmak için yine de içeri girmemiz gerekecek.
The Missing Piece#275.speaker: Inspector

The Missing Piece#276.src: If you won't be of any use, then you better get out of our way!
The Missing Piece#276.dst: Bir faydan olmayacaksa, yolumuzdan çekilsen iyi edersin!
The Missing Piece#276.speaker: Inspector

The Missing Piece#277.src: At the bread factory? That's none of our concern, we're the Water Authority, not the Bread Authority!
The Missing Piece#277.dst: Ekmek fabrikasında mı? Orası bizi ilgilendirmez, biz Su İdaresiyiz, Ekmek İdaresi değil!
The Missing Piece#277.speaker: Inspector

The Missing Piece#278.src: A massive water spillage, you say!?
The Missing Piece#278.dst: Büyük bir su sızıntısı mı dedin!?
The Missing Piece#278.speaker: Inspector

The Missing Piece#279.src: And you're not making this up? We don't take easily to liars, you should know.
The Missing Piece#279.dst: Ve bunu uydurmuyorsun, değil mi? Yalancılara hiç hoş bakmayız, bilmiş ol.
The Missing Piece#279.speaker: Inspector

The Missing Piece#280.src: Inspector, there seems to be some commotion coming from the Bread Factory.
The Missing Piece#280.dst: Müfettiş, Ekmek Fabrikası tarafından bir kargaşa sesi geliyor gibi.
The Missing Piece#280.speaker: Sentinel

The Missing Piece#281.src: Hmm... Well, in that case, we'll have to check it out. Thank you for the information, citizen.
The Missing Piece#281.dst: Hmm... Eh, o hâlde gidip bakmamız lazım. Bilgi için teşekkürler, vatandaş.
The Missing Piece#281.speaker: Inspector

The Missing Piece#282.src: Passing by! As if! Did you really think I would believe that story?
The Missing Piece#282.dst: Geçiyormuş! Hadi oradan! Gerçekten bu hikâyeye inanacağımı mı sandın?
The Missing Piece#282.speaker: Inspector

The Missing Piece#284.src: We are here to execute a search. Your water usage levels have exceeded your authorized allotment.
The Missing Piece#284.dst: Arama yapmak için buradayız. Su kullanımın izin verilen kotayı aştı.
The Missing Piece#284.speaker: Inspector

The Missing Piece#287.src: Very well. We will now conduct an inspection of your property. Step out of the way, subject.
The Missing Piece#287.dst: Pekâlâ. Şimdi mülkünü teftiş edeceğiz. Yoldan çekil, tebaa.
The Missing Piece#287.speaker: Inspector

The Missing Piece#288.src: What's this? No wonder you're exceeding your water limit when you've been keeping illicit plants!
The Missing Piece#288.dst: Bu da ne? Kaçak bitkiler besliyorsan su limitini aşmana şaşmamalı!
The Missing Piece#288.speaker: Inspector

The Missing Piece#289.src: Wait a second... There's someone hiding behind there! You said you were alone!
The Missing Piece#289.dst: Bir saniye... Orada arkada saklanan biri var! Yalnız olduğunu söylemiştin!
The Missing Piece#289.speaker: Inspector

The Missing Piece#294.src: Noooooooo, Alphonse! How... How could you do this!?
The Missing Piece#294.dst: Hayıııır, Alphonse! Bunu... Bunu nasıl yaparsın!?
The Missing Piece#294.speaker: Inspector

The Missing Piece#295.src: You'll pay for this, you rat! In the name of Her Majesty!
The Missing Piece#295.dst: Bunu ödeyeceksin, seni sıçan! Majesteleri adına!
The Missing Piece#295.speaker: Inspector

The Missing Piece#296.src: Are you alright!? I heard a commotion, and
The Missing Piece#296.dst: İyi misin!? Bir gürültü duydum, sonra
The Missing Piece#296.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#298.src: You may as well come inside, dearie.
The Missing Piece#298.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#300.src: But how strange... The authorities have never bothered me before... Oh, let's just get inside for now.
The Missing Piece#300.dst: Ama ne tuhaf... Yetkililer daha önce beni hiç rahatsız etmemişti... Neyse, şimdilik içeri girelim.
The Missing Piece#300.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#301.src: Find somewhere to hide in Elise's house!
The Missing Piece#301.dst: Elise'in evinde saklanacak bir yer bul!

The Missing Piece#304.src: There you go. Now, what business could Her Majesty's authorities possibly have with little old me?
The Missing Piece#304.dst: Buyurun. Peki, Majesteleri'nin yetkililerinin benim gibi zavallı bir yaşlıyla ne işi olabilir?
The Missing Piece#304.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#305.src: We are here to execute a search. You water usage levels have exceeded you authorized allotment.
The Missing Piece#305.dst: Arama yapmak için buradayız. Su kullanım seviyen izin verilen kotayı aştı.
The Missing Piece#305.speaker: Inspector

The Missing Piece#310.src: We'll be done here after we've finished our inspection.
The Missing Piece#310.speaker: Inspector

The Missing Piece#311.src: Say, would you prefer us searching the lower or upper floor first?
The Missing Piece#311.dst: Söylesene, önce alt katı mı üst katı mı aramamızı tercih edersin?
The Missing Piece#311.speaker: Inspector

The Missing Piece#312.src: How kind of you to ask... but as there is nothing of interest anywhere, I would suggest you start by finding a reason to get out of my home.
The Missing Piece#312.dst: Sormanız ne nazik... ama hiçbir yerde ilginç bir şey olmadığına göre, evimden çıkmak için bir bahane bularak başlamanızı öneririm.
The Missing Piece#312.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#313.src: I wouldn't want to waste your time, is all.
The Missing Piece#313.dst: Vaktinizi boşa harcamak istemem, o kadar.
The Missing Piece#313.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#314.src: The lower floor then. Thank you for your cooperation.
The Missing Piece#314.dst: O hâlde alt kat. İş birliğin için teşekkürler.
The Missing Piece#314.speaker: Inspector

The Missing Piece#318.src: Oh what's the matter with you!?
The Missing Piece#318.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#319.src: I've worked my whole life in the factories! Can't I have some flowers to keep me company in my old age?
The Missing Piece#319.dst: Bütün ömrüm fabrikalarda çalışarak geçti! Yaşlılığımda bana arkadaşlık edecek birkaç çiçeğim olamaz mı?
The Missing Piece#319.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#320.src: Inspector. A message from the Authority.
The Missing Piece#320.speaker: Sentinel

The Missing Piece#332.src: How kind of you to ask... but as the upper floor is my bedroom, I would prefer it if you didn't inspect my bedsheets.
The Missing Piece#332.dst: Sormanız ne nazik... ama üst kat yatak odam, çarşaflarımı teftiş etmemenizi tercih ederim.
The Missing Piece#332.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#333.src: The upper floor then. Thank you for your cooperation.
The Missing Piece#333.dst: O hâlde üst kat. İş birliğin için teşekkürler.
The Missing Piece#333.speaker: Inspector

The Missing Piece#339.src: How quaint. Doesn't it get lonely, living up here all by your lonesome?
The Missing Piece#339.dst: Ne şirin. Burada tek başına yaşamak insana yalnız hissettirmiyor mu?
The Missing Piece#339.speaker: Inspector

The Missing Piece#341.src: Anyhow, I am required to inform you that you are in breach of the ordinance on water usage and will have to-
The Missing Piece#341.dst: Her neyse, su kullanımına dair yönetmeliği ihlal ettiğini bildirmekle yükümlüyüm ve şunu yapman gerekecek-
The Missing Piece#341.speaker: Inspector

The Missing Piece#355.src: Well, seems you're in luck this time, subject.
The Missing Piece#355.speaker: Inspector

The Missing Piece#356.src: Some higher authority has overruled our command... we're being recalled.
The Missing Piece#356.dst: Daha üst bir makam emrimizi iptal etti... geri çağrılıyoruz.
The Missing Piece#356.speaker: Inspector

The Missing Piece#357.src: But don't be mistaken. We'll be back!
The Missing Piece#357.speaker: Inspector

The Missing Piece#358.src: Well, you won't be welcome next time!
The Missing Piece#358.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#359.src: Nuisances, all of them... Well, it worked out in the end, didn't it?
The Missing Piece#359.dst: Başbelaları, hepsi... Neyse, sonunda her şey yoluna girdi, değil mi?
The Missing Piece#359.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#360.src: They're gone, you can come out now.
The Missing Piece#360.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#361.src: Come, let's sit down and have a talk.
The Missing Piece#361.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#364.src: Right! The bread! So forgetful these days...
The Missing Piece#364.dst: Doğru! Ekmek! Bu aralar ne kadar unutkanım...
The Missing Piece#364.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#365.src: Well? How did it go? Did you get any? I hope it wasn't too much trouble...
The Missing Piece#365.dst: Eee? Nasıl geçti? Biraz alabildin mi? Umarım başını fazla derde sokmamıştır...
The Missing Piece#365.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#366.src: Oh, wonderful. Thank you. That should be everything we need...
The Missing Piece#366.dst: Ah, harika. Teşekkürler. İhtiyacımız olan her şey tamam sayılır...
The Missing Piece#366.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#367.src: Well, if there was no other way... If the Authority is going to stomp in here looking for plants, taking a loaf of bread in return seems like a fair deal!
The Missing Piece#367.dst: Eh, başka yolu yoksa... İdare buraya bitki aramak için paldır küldür dalacaksa, karşılığında bir somun ekmek almak adil bir anlaşma gibi!
The Missing Piece#367.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#369.src: Ah... How nostalgic. It really does bring me back to those good old days.
The Missing Piece#369.dst: Ah... Ne kadar nostaljik. Beni gerçekten o güzel eski günlere götürüyor.
The Missing Piece#369.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#370.src: There was one time though... We... No, I bought it... Argh, why can't I remember!
The Missing Piece#370.dst: Bir keresinde ama... Biz... Hayır, ben almıştım... Ah, neden hatırlayamıyorum!
The Missing Piece#370.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#371.src: How strange... Again, this feeling... As if- as if there's something I should be remembering... but can't.
The Missing Piece#371.dst: Ne tuhaf... Yine bu his... Sanki- sanki hatırlamam gereken bir şey var... ama hatırlayamıyorum.
The Missing Piece#371.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#373.src: Do you remember how we first met? All those years ago?
The Missing Piece#373.dst: İlk nasıl tanıştığımızı hatırlıyor musun? Onca yıl önce?

The Missing Piece#374.src: Of course I do! But... thinking about it now, maybe I was a bit... cold.
The Missing Piece#374.dst: Tabii hatırlıyorum! Ama... şimdi düşününce, biraz... soğuk davranmış olabilirim.
The Missing Piece#374.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#375.src: You were fine! You were the only one who...

The Missing Piece#377.src: You were the only one who even noticed I was there.
The Missing Piece#377.dst: Orada olduğumu fark eden tek kişi sendin.

The Missing Piece#378.src: Ah- hello. I'm {u}, I'm new here. Nice to meet you.
The Missing Piece#378.dst: Ah- merhaba. Ben {u}, burada yeniyim. Tanıştığımıza memnun oldum.

The Missing Piece#379.src: The name's Elise, do a good job and I'm sure we'll get along.
The Missing Piece#379.dst: Adım Elise, işini iyi yaparsan anlaşacağımıza eminim.
The Missing Piece#379.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#380.src: Right, yes. Of course... I'll try my best!
The Missing Piece#380.dst: Doğru, evet. Tabii... Elimden geleni yapacağım!

The Missing Piece#381.src: ... You know what, have this. It'll help you get through the day.
The Missing Piece#381.dst: ... Biliyor musun, al bunu. Günü atlatmana yardım eder.
The Missing Piece#381.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#385.src: Really? I was only working there for a month!
The Missing Piece#385.dst: Gerçekten mi? Orada sadece bir ay çalışmıştım!

The Missing Piece#386.src: Oh, sure... but it was a good month, wasn't it?
The Missing Piece#386.dst: Ah, tabii... ama güzel bir aydı, değil mi?
The Missing Piece#386.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#387.src: And even after you were transferred away... I had something to look forward to at the end of my shifts.
The Missing Piece#387.dst: Sen başka yere tayin edildikten sonra bile... vardiyalarımın sonunda dört gözle beklediğim bir şey vardı.
The Missing Piece#387.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#388.src: Ah... well... now you have something to look forward to when you come home, as well.
The Missing Piece#388.dst: Ah... eh... artık eve döndüğünde de dört gözle bekleyeceğin bir şey var.

The Missing Piece#389.src: Ha! I guess I do, don't I...
The Missing Piece#389.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#390.src: But it all seems so small from up here... doesn't it? Just look at the view!
The Missing Piece#390.dst: Ama buradan her şey ne kadar küçük görünüyor... değil mi? Şu manzaraya bak!
The Missing Piece#390.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#391.src: It really is beautiful... up here, it's like nothing else matters except for us.
The Missing Piece#391.dst: Gerçekten çok güzel... burada sanki bizden başka hiçbir şeyin önemi yok.

The Missing Piece#392.src: ...I wish we could stay like this forever...
The Missing Piece#392.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#393.src: ...oh. So do I, Elise... so do I...

The Missing Piece#394.src: Ha, but why do you sound so sad?
The Missing Piece#394.dst: Ha, ama neden bu kadar hüzünlü konuşuyorsun?
The Missing Piece#394.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#396.src: It's nothing... we'll stay like this... forever. I promise.
The Missing Piece#396.dst: Bir şey yok... böyle kalacağız... sonsuza dek. Söz veriyorum.

The Missing Piece#397.src: Her, again... Who is she? Why am I remembering these things?
The Missing Piece#397.dst: Yine o kadın... Kim bu? Neden bunları hatırlıyorum?
The Missing Piece#397.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#399.src: Well, there's nothing that can be done about it now, is there? Say, why don't we head out?
The Missing Piece#399.dst: Eh, artık bu konuda yapılacak bir şey yok, değil mi? Söylesene, neden dışarı çıkmıyoruz?
The Missing Piece#399.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#400.src: Oh, dear. Did I forget to tell you? The bread is for a picnic!
The Missing Piece#400.dst: Aman. Sana söylemeyi unuttum mu? Ekmek piknik için!
The Missing Piece#400.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#401.src: I know the perfect place... in fact, you reminded me of it. It has a view over the entire Roughworks, can you believe that?
The Missing Piece#401.dst: Mükemmel bir yer biliyorum... hatta onu bana sen hatırlattın. Bütün Roughworks'e tepeden bakıyor, inanabiliyor musun?
The Missing Piece#401.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#402.src: Although... Thinking about it, it's a bit far... I don't know if my old legs will carry me all the way there, ha!
The Missing Piece#402.dst: Gerçi... Düşününce biraz uzak... Bu yaşlı bacaklar beni oraya kadar taşır mı bilmiyorum, ha!
The Missing Piece#402.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#403.src: Someone around here has to have the code to this...

The Missing Piece#404.src: Now all you have to do is get out of this place somehow...
The Missing Piece#404.dst: Şimdi tek yapman gereken bir şekilde buradan çıkmak...

The Missing Piece#405.src: Maybe if you hit those bottles, it will move the beam.
The Missing Piece#405.dst: Belki o şişeleri vurursan kiriş hareket eder.

The Missing Piece#408.dst: Gerçekten mi? Ah, çok teşekkür ederim!
The Missing Piece#408.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#409.src: Well, what do you say, then? Just talk to me when you want to head out.
The Missing Piece#409.dst: Eee, ne dersin? Çıkmak istediğinde benimle konuşman yeter.
The Missing Piece#409.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#411.src: Well, what do you say? Shall we head out?
The Missing Piece#411.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#414.src: Oh, you can really see a lot from up here... Let's go!
The Missing Piece#414.dst: Ah, buradan gerçekten çok şey görünüyor... Hadi!
The Missing Piece#414.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#415.src: Where to? I know just the place for this! Let's see, it's...
The Missing Piece#415.dst: Nereye mi? Bunun için tam yeri biliyorum! Bakalım, şeydi...
The Missing Piece#415.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#416.src: Hm... I think... Forward! Yes, I think it was straight forward from here. Although, my memory might be a little hazy...
The Missing Piece#416.dst: Hm... Sanırım... İleri! Evet, sanırım buradan dümdüzdü. Gerçi hafızam biraz bulanık olabilir...
The Missing Piece#416.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#418.src: Ah, hm... I think we turn left here...
The Missing Piece#418.dst: Ah, hm... Sanırım burada sola dönüyoruz...
The Missing Piece#418.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#419.src: No, wait... It's right, we definitely have to turn right!
The Missing Piece#419.dst: Hayır, dur... Sağdı, kesinlikle sağa dönmemiz lazım!
The Missing Piece#419.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#421.src: That house feels familiar... I think... yes, turn right here!
The Missing Piece#421.dst: Şu ev tanıdık geliyor... Sanırım... evet, burada sağa dön!
The Missing Piece#421.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#423.src: Stop! Hmm... I don't think it's across this bridge, at least. Then that must mean...
The Missing Piece#423.dst: Dur! Hmm... En azından bu köprünün karşısında değil bence. O zaman demek ki...
The Missing Piece#423.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#424.src: Oh, what's the matter! We'll find it eventually, right? I'm pretty sure it's to the left!
The Missing Piece#424.dst: Ah, ne var! Eninde sonunda buluruz, değil mi? Galiba solda, neredeyse eminim!
The Missing Piece#424.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#426.src: Yes, this is it! It's just around this corner, I'm sure of it!
The Missing Piece#426.dst: Evet, burası! Hemen şu köşenin ardında, eminim!
The Missing Piece#426.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#428.src: Here! I remember now... it's in here!
The Missing Piece#428.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#429.src: I don't remember it being so overgrown, though...
The Missing Piece#429.dst: Gerçi bu kadar otla kaplı olduğunu hatırlamıyorum...
The Missing Piece#429.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#430.src: How long has it been? I can't recall the last time I was here...
The Missing Piece#430.dst: Ne kadar zaman oldu? Buraya en son ne zaman geldiğimi hatırlayamıyorum...
The Missing Piece#430.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#432.src: Ah, it's blocked... Well. I didn't want to bring it up, but it seems we're out of options.
The Missing Piece#432.dst: Ah, yol kapalı... Eh. Açmak istemiyordum, ama başka seçeneğimiz kalmadı galiba.
The Missing Piece#432.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#433.src: Oh, there's no need to pretend anymore. I know what you are. You're one of them, aren't you?
The Missing Piece#433.dst: Ah, artık rol yapmana gerek yok. Ne olduğunu biliyorum. Onlardan birisin, değil mi?
The Missing Piece#433.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#434.src: The cursed, as the Crown calls them. Not that I care!
The Missing Piece#434.dst: Lanetliler, Kraliyet'in deyişiyle. Umurumda olduğundan değil!
The Missing Piece#434.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#435.src: Why should I? I'm old! I have enough to worry about as is...
The Missing Piece#435.dst: Neden umurumda olsun? Ben yaşlıyım! Zaten yeterince derdim var...
The Missing Piece#435.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#436.src: Besides, it's certainly useful in situations like this, isn't it? Be a dearie and do one of your little tricks, won't you?
The Missing Piece#436.dst: Hem, böyle durumlarda kesinlikle işe yarıyor, değil mi? Hadi canım, şu küçük numaralarından birini yap, olur mu?
The Missing Piece#436.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#438.src: That's it... Let me down now, I can walk the rest of the way myself.
The Missing Piece#438.dst: İşte bu... Şimdi indir beni, yolun kalanını kendim yürüyebilirim.
The Missing Piece#438.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#440.src: It's a little more... well, deserted, than I remember. But that's fine.
The Missing Piece#440.dst: Hatırladığımdan biraz daha... eh, ıssız. Ama olsun.
The Missing Piece#440.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#441.src: We can take this elevator to the top. You'll have to find a way into the control room though... It shouldn't be too hard to reach!
The Missing Piece#441.dst: Bu asansörle tepeye çıkabiliriz. Ama kontrol odasına girmenin bir yolunu bulman gerekecek... Ulaşması çok zor olmamalı!
The Missing Piece#441.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#442.src: It's that thing up over there. The tunnel on the right will get you to it.
The Missing Piece#442.dst: Şu yukarıdaki şey. Sağdaki tünel seni oraya götürür.
The Missing Piece#442.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#446.src: Can you hear me? I'm down here!
The Missing Piece#446.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#447.src: Use the controls to get me up! You know how it works, right?
The Missing Piece#447.dst: Kumandaları kullanıp beni yukarı çıkar! Nasıl çalıştığını biliyorsun, değil mi?
The Missing Piece#447.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#448.src: Use the controls at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] to bring Elise up.
The Missing Piece#448.dst: Elise'i yukarı çıkarmak için [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] konumundaki kumandaları kullan.

The Missing Piece#451.src: Maybe if... oh, I know. Put something on the up button, then you can clear the blockage... and we'll go up.
The Missing Piece#451.dst: Belki eğer... ah, buldum. Yukarı düğmesinin üstüne bir şey koy, sonra tıkanıklığı açarsın... ve yukarı çıkarız.
The Missing Piece#451.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#452.src: Perfect! Now it will move, if only we can get it unstuck...
The Missing Piece#452.dst: Mükemmel! Artık hareket eder, yeter ki sıkıştığı yerden kurtarabilelim...
The Missing Piece#452.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#453.src: If you could get up there, somehow...
The Missing Piece#453.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#455.src: Oh well, this place seems abandoned anyhow! Who cares about a little destruction?
The Missing Piece#455.dst: Aman, burası zaten terk edilmiş gibi! Biraz hasar kimin umurunda?
The Missing Piece#455.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#456.src: Go up there and see if you can find a way to get this thing going again.
The Missing Piece#456.dst: Yukarı çık ve şu şeyi yeniden çalıştırmanın bir yolunu bulabilecek misin, bak.
The Missing Piece#456.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#458.src: Throw a brick at the blockage at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Missing Piece#459.src: How's it going? Can you see anything?
The Missing Piece#459.dst: Nasıl gidiyor? Bir şey görebiliyor musun?
The Missing Piece#459.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#466.src: Follow Elise to the cliff at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
The Missing Piece#466.dst: Elise'i [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] konumundaki uçuruma kadar takip et.

The Missing Piece#467.src: Ah, isn't this place nice. The breeze, the view, everything.
The Missing Piece#467.dst: Ah, burası ne güzel. Esinti, manzara, her şey.
The Missing Piece#467.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#468.src: You can even see the trees of the {p} swaying from up here...
The Missing Piece#468.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#469.src: And finally! A place to sit! I'm sorely in need of some relaxation after this eventful day.
The Missing Piece#469.dst: Ve nihayet! Oturacak bir yer! Bu olaylı günden sonra biraz dinlenmeye çok ihtiyacım var.
The Missing Piece#469.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#470.src: Please, let's sit down and enjoy the view for a bit.
The Missing Piece#470.dst: Lütfen, oturup biraz manzaranın tadını çıkaralım.
The Missing Piece#470.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#472.src: Hm. It's strange. All day, I've been... reminiscing, I suppose. And now, seeing this view... it fills me with that same, nostalgic feeling.
The Missing Piece#472.dst: Hm. Tuhaf. Bütün gün... eski günleri anıp durdum galiba. Şimdi de bu manzarayı görünce... içim aynı nostaljik hisle doluyor.
The Missing Piece#472.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#476.src: You should probably take your place at the front of the line.
The Missing Piece#476.dst: Sıranın en önündeki yerini alsan iyi olur.

The Missing Piece#477.src: All day, I've been having these... visions of the past. Of these things I can't recall ever happening.
The Missing Piece#477.dst: Bütün gün şu... geçmişe dair görüntüler görüyorum. Yaşadığımı hiç hatırlamadığım şeyler.
The Missing Piece#477.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#478.src: And I... well, truthfully, I'm not sure how to feel about it...
The Missing Piece#478.dst: Ve ben... açıkçası, bu konuda ne hissedeceğimi bilmiyorum...
The Missing Piece#478.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#479.src: But I know- I know in my heart, that there's something missing... a piece that would make it all fit.
The Missing Piece#479.dst: Ama biliyorum- kalbimde biliyorum, bir şey eksik... her şeyi yerine oturtacak bir parça.
The Missing Piece#479.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#481.src: In every dream she's there beside me... but I don't even remember her name. I can't even recall her face...
The Missing Piece#481.dst: Her rüyada yanımda... ama adını bile hatırlamıyorum. Yüzünü bile hatırlayamıyorum...
The Missing Piece#481.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#482.src: If she was this important to me... then how could I forget?
The Missing Piece#482.dst: Benim için bu kadar önemliyse... nasıl unutabildim?
The Missing Piece#482.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#485.src: Hurgh... hurgh... One second, I need to catch my breath.
The Missing Piece#485.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#486.src: Hm... Do you know this person? They're not an inspector... are they?
The Missing Piece#486.dst: Hm... Bu kişiyi tanıyor musun? Müfettiş değil... değil mi?
The Missing Piece#486.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#487.src: So, as I was going to say-
The Missing Piece#487.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#488.src: Okay, fine! I'll get straight to the point.
The Missing Piece#488.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#489.src: I found more letters to deliver, and I was on my way to deliver them when I saw you two running out! Can you imagine how shocked I was?
The Missing Piece#489.dst: Teslim edilecek başka mektuplar buldum, onları götürürken ikinizin koşarak çıktığını gördüm! Ne kadar şaşırdığımı tahmin edebiliyor musunuz?
The Missing Piece#489.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#490.src: That being that, I naturally decided to follow you, the good postmaster that I am. You sure didn't make it easy though! I barely managed to make it up here... It's a nice spot, by the way.
The Missing Piece#490.dst: Haliyle, iyi bir posta müdürü olarak sizi takip etmeye karar verdim. Hiç de kolaylaştırmadınız ama! Buraya zar zor çıkabildim... Bu arada güzel yer.
The Missing Piece#490.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#491.src: But... how could you have possibly made it up here...?
The Missing Piece#491.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#492.src: Getting up here is nothing to a university graduate like me!
The Missing Piece#492.dst: Buraya çıkmak benim gibi bir üniversite mezunu için çocuk oyuncağı!
The Missing Piece#492.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#495.src: Well, that was all that I came for I suppose. So...
The Missing Piece#495.dst: Eh, sanırım tek gelme sebebim buydu. Yani...
The Missing Piece#495.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#496.src: You came all this way just for that!? At least have a piece of bread, or something...!
The Missing Piece#496.dst: Bunca yolu sırf bunun için mi geldin!? Hiç değilse bir parça ekmek al bari...!
The Missing Piece#496.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#497.src: No, no. I couldn't possibly! Duty calls, the post isn't going to sort itself, and all that... Oh, by Her Majesty, the backlog...
The Missing Piece#497.dst: Yok, yok. Asla olmaz! Görev çağırıyor, posta kendi kendini ayırmaz, falan filan... Ah, Majesteleri aşkına, biriken işler...
The Missing Piece#497.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#498.src: Right! You! I hate to admit it, but it seems you've done your job well enough.
The Missing Piece#498.dst: Doğru! Sen! Kabul etmekten nefret ediyorum, ama işini yeterince iyi yapmış gibisin.
The Missing Piece#498.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#499.src: I happened to double check the records and it seems like my substitute, well, may have been someone else entirely!
The Missing Piece#499.dst: Kayıtları bir daha kontrol ettim de, vekilim galiba, şey, bambaşka biriymiş!
The Missing Piece#499.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#500.src: No harm, no foul, right? The work's already done! No takesies-backsies! Okay?
The Missing Piece#500.dst: Zarar yok, ziyan yok, değil mi? İş zaten yapıldı! Geri almak yok! Tamam mı?
The Missing Piece#500.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#502.src: Huh, what was that? I couldn't hear you! Okay, bye!
The Missing Piece#502.dst: Ha, ne dedin? Duyamadım! Tamam, hoşça kal!
The Missing Piece#502.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#504.src: But it was certainly nice of them to deliver this letter. Let me take a look.
The Missing Piece#504.dst: Ama bu mektubu getirmesi kesinlikle çok incelikliydi. Bir bakayım.
The Missing Piece#504.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#506.src: Oh, I don't understand... What would she have to apologize for?
The Missing Piece#506.dst: Ah, anlamıyorum... Onun özür dileyecek neyi olabilir ki?
The Missing Piece#506.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#507.src: Please... {u}, take a breath. You're shaking.
The Missing Piece#507.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#509.src: Getting caught in a storm like that... really, I could have waited a few hours! You didn't need to push yourself to get here.
The Missing Piece#509.dst: Öyle bir fırtınaya yakalanmak... gerçekten, birkaç saat bekleyebilirdim! Buraya gelmek için kendini zorlamana gerek yoktu.
The Missing Piece#509.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#511.src: Yes, I know the weather's bad now... but eventually, it'll get better again. The clouds will clear and the sun will shine again. Right?
The Missing Piece#511.dst: Evet, biliyorum, hava şu an kötü... ama eninde sonunda düzelecek. Bulutlar dağılacak ve güneş yeniden parlayacak. Değil mi?
The Missing Piece#511.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#513.src: You know, it's not so bad with rain once in a while. Means we don't have to water the flowers, at least! And nothing beats the smell of wet grass after rain, don't you agree?
The Missing Piece#513.dst: Biliyor musun, arada bir yağmur yağması o kadar da kötü değil. En azından çiçekleri sulamamız gerekmiyor! Hem yağmurdan sonraki ıslak çimen kokusunun üstüne yoktur, değil mi?
The Missing Piece#513.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#514.src: We could do something after it clears up. It's been a while since you visited, so why not go to our spot? I should still have some leftover bread lying around...
The Missing Piece#514.dst: Hava açılınca bir şeyler yapabiliriz. Uğramayalı epey oldu, neden bizim yere gitmiyoruz? Ortalıkta hâlâ biraz ekmek kalmış olmalı...
The Missing Piece#514.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#515.src: Elise. You're- please, forgive me- you're in danger. I-
The Missing Piece#515.dst: Elise. Sen- lütfen, beni affet- sen tehlikedesin. Ben-

The Missing Piece#516.src: I'm in danger? I'm just an ordinary worker, what reason would anyone have to harm me? I'll be fine.
The Missing Piece#516.dst: Ben mi tehlikedeyim? Sıradan bir işçiyim, kim neden bana zarar vermek istesin? Bana bir şey olmaz.
The Missing Piece#516.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#517.src: {u}, you're the one pushing herself through this weather, clearly panicking...
The Missing Piece#517.dst: {u}, bu havada kendini zorlayan, belli ki paniğe kapılmış olan sensin...
The Missing Piece#517.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#518.src: I barely get to see you anymore. And now, out of nowhere, you're here in this state... What's going on? Please, just talk to me.
The Missing Piece#518.dst: Seni artık neredeyse hiç göremiyorum. Şimdi de birdenbire bu hâlde buradasın... Neler oluyor? Lütfen, sadece konuş benimle.
The Missing Piece#518.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#519.src: ...ha. I- I haven't been truthful with you, Elise, and- I can explain later. We need to get out of here, before they-
The Missing Piece#519.dst: ...ha. Ben- sana karşı dürüst olmadım, Elise, ve- sonra açıklarım. Buradan gitmeliyiz, onlar-

The Missing Piece#522.src: Why would they... no, this doesn't make any sense...
The Missing Piece#522.dst: Neden... hayır, bunun hiçbir anlamı yok...

The Missing Piece#523.src: Hm. Well, then maybe it's nothing. I'll go see who it is.
The Missing Piece#523.dst: Hm. O zaman belki bir şey yoktur. Gidip kim olduğuna bakayım.
The Missing Piece#523.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#524.src: As if one wasn't enough... who could possibly be foolish enough to brave a storm just to come visit this little place? Whatever it is, it can wait.
The Missing Piece#524.dst: Biri yetmezmiş gibi... kim sırf bu küçük yere gelmek için fırtınaya göğüs gerecek kadar aptal olabilir ki? Her neyse, bekleyebilir.
The Missing Piece#524.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#527.src: No... No... What are you... Why are you-
The Missing Piece#527.dst: Hayır... Hayır... Siz ne... Neden siz-
The Missing Piece#527.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#528.src: Apologies for the disturbance, madam. But I'm afraid we have business to attend to.
The Missing Piece#528.dst: Rahatsızlık için özür dilerim, hanımefendi. Ama korkarım halletmemiz gereken bir iş var.
The Missing Piece#528.speaker: Inquisitor

The Missing Piece#530.src: {u}, {u}, why are they here? Why... why won't you answer me...?
The Missing Piece#530.dst: {u}, {u}, neden buradalar? Neden... neden bana cevap vermiyorsun...?
The Missing Piece#530.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#531.src: What have you done? I... Please, just explain... I- I...
The Missing Piece#531.dst: Ne yaptın? Ben... Lütfen, sadece açıkla... Ben- ben...
The Missing Piece#531.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#532.src: I... how did I overlook this...?

The Missing Piece#533.src: Seems you're not quite the strategic mastermind you though yourself, Lioness.
The Missing Piece#533.dst: Görünen o ki sandığın kadar dâhi bir stratejist değilmişsin, Dişi Aslan.
The Missing Piece#533.speaker: Inquisitor

The Missing Piece#535.src: Elise... if you... if you just cooperate...
The Missing Piece#535.dst: Elise... eğer... eğer iş birliği yaparsan...

The Missing Piece#536.src: Then... everything will be fine. It... it will.
The Missing Piece#536.dst: O zaman... her şey yoluna girecek. Girecek... gerçekten.

The Missing Piece#539.src: She... What did she do? Why did she wrap me up in it?
The Missing Piece#539.dst: O... Ne yaptı? Beni neden bu işe bulaştırdı?
The Missing Piece#539.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#540.src: Everything I remember... it just leaves me with more questions than answers. Why can't I remember her...? Why!?
The Missing Piece#540.dst: Hatırladığım her şey... bana cevaptan çok soru bırakıyor. Neden onu hatırlayamıyorum...? Neden!?
The Missing Piece#540.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#541.src: I- I'm just an ordinary factory worker! I woke up early, worked late, slept late... then did it all over again the next day.
The Missing Piece#541.dst: Ben- ben sadece sıradan bir fabrika işçisiyim! Erken kalktım, geç saate kadar çalıştım, geç yattım... ertesi gün hepsini yeniden yaptım.
The Missing Piece#541.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#542.src: I've never said a word about the Crown! Why would they possibly care about... me...?
The Missing Piece#542.dst: Kraliyet hakkında tek kelime etmedim! Neden... benimle ilgilensinler ki...?
The Missing Piece#542.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#543.src: They... they took everything from me. My youth, my body, my time, and... and I never demanded anything in return.
